bundled.note: mermaid.min.js inlines these, so an OSV query on mermaid alone does not see them. DOMPurify 3.4.12 has known advisories fixed in 3.4.17; KaTeX 0.16.47 has a prototype-pollution-precondition advisory fixed in 0.18.2. The current strict renderer calls DOMPurify for labels and final SVG serialization; exact advisory-path reachability is not established and the critical finding is not accepted away. Official Mermaid 12.3.0 now bundles DOMPurify 3.4.17 and KaTeX 0.18.11, but also adds ELK and changes bundle/layout/licensing considerations. A bounded fixed-dependency remediation is under review in #322; these recorded shipped bytes remain unchanged until its producer, receipt and browser acceptance are complete.
